issue_context.title: [Bug]: Incorrect length calculation with Chinese symbols in Line Reporter
issue_context.body:
### Version

1.46.0

### Steps to reproduce

Create a test step with Chinese symbols, like this "诶开伊艾西吉艾艾伊娜伊"

### Expected behavior

The line reporter must work in a line.

### Actual behavior

The line reporter incorrect work because if we use the 10 Chinese symbols it`s not equal length 10, it prints text to second line after this delete line and write new and the first line remain displayed.

### Additional context

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/eb6231cd-22ed-484f-8872-87a8a07c0830)


### Environment

System:
  OS: Windows 11 23H2 22631.4037
  CPU: (16) x64
Binaries:
  Node: 22.1.0
  npm: 10.8.3
npmPackages:
  @playwright/test: 1.46.0

review_comments: Sounds like this is no better than `for (const segment of v)` in your use case.
It makes a difference for grapheme clusters, see https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String/Symbol.iterator#description
